webhooks.detail: Webhook Events: configure a public Webhook Events URL; Discord POSTs events (APPLICATION_AUTHORIZED/DEAUTHORIZED, ENTITLEMENT_*, LOBBY_MESSAGE_*, GAME_DIRECT_MESSAGE_*). Message/guild events come via Gateway websocket, not webhooks.

evidence.quote: Webhook events are one-way events sent to your app over HTTP to notify you when an event occurred.

sandbox.detail: Anyone can create an application/bot in the Developer Portal and test in own servers or with whitelisted test accounts. Pricing not stated on fetched pages; free is general knowledge, no formal sandbox.

evidence.quote: Make sure any test account is added to the application's App Whitelist in the portal!

rate_limits.summary: 50 requests/sec global per bot, plus per-route limits via X-RateLimit headers

evidence.quote: All bots can make up to 50 requests per second to our API.

official: typescript (Embedded App SDK for Activities only; Game SDK archived; no official REST/bot client libs)

evidence.quote: Discord does not maintain official SDKs.
This repository contains the public preview of the OpenAPI 3.1 specification for Discord's API.
